{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./smcabc.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   -t 2:00:00            -> -t 2h
#   -N 1                  -> -N 1
#   --tasks-per-node=1     -> -n 1
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -t 2h --wrap "sh $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm -A lu2020-2-7 not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require project/account out-of-band.

  # NOTE: Slurm -p lu not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the lu partition.

  # NOTE: Slurm --exclusive not translated.
  # Performance implication: without exclusive-node allocation, the job may share the node with other jobs, potentially reducing performance.

  # NOTE: Slurm -J smcabc not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm -o/-e used %j expansion (jobid) which Flux does not provide portably.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: log filenames may not be unique unless you add uniqueness.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mail-user/--mail-type not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: no email notifications.

  ml load GCC/8.3.0
  ml load CUDA/10.1.243
  ml load OpenMPI/3.1.4
  ml load PyTorch/1.6.0-Python-3.7.4

  flux run -n 1 python /home/samwiq/snpla/seq-posterior-approx-w-nf-dev/two_moons/run_script_smcabc.py 1 2 8 10
fi
"
}
